title: MODFLOW6 Prepared-Solve Iterative Backend

canonical_reconciliation.head: 7b864853ca22baa73141b2dec9ed2f3915ef520d
canonical_reconciliation.note: Current canonical includes later active-drainage tangent work; F-GC38 lifecycle qualification is orthogonal to tangent coverage.

source_evidence.mf6xmi: XMI explicitly supports external nonlinear coupling by exchanging data between repeated solve calls inside one prepare_solve/finalize_solve pair.
source_evidence.gwf_ad: Normal prepare_solve copies current X into XOLD once; repeated solve calls do not recopy XOLD.
source_evidence.storage: STO uses XOLD as previous-time head and X as current iterate.
source_evidence.imod_coupler: MetaSWAP-MODFLOW implementation calls mf6.prepare_solve once, repeatedly solves MetaSWAP/MODFLOW in one loop, and finalizes solve once.

architecture_decision.accepted_groundwater_origin: prepared timestep state plus fixed XOLD
architecture_decision.outer_groundwater_iterate: current X within one prepared MODFLOW solve
architecture_decision.per_iteration_rollback: not required and not the intended XMI coupling model
architecture_decision.whole_window_abort: not yet externally restorable; separate restart concern

next_permitted_action: Implement and live-qualify a prepared-solve session against official MODFLOW6 6.8.0, real xmipy pointers and the real F-GC34 bridge.
